line.comment: * Add-Ons 2.0.4: Rebalanced starting Xenon station defenders.
* Reduced station density (see Mayhem.GameCreator.SpawnXenons) is compensated by tighter ship-count ranges
* and stronger capital-ship probabilities on higher difficulties. Added J and Z to M7 and M2 pool, with support ships included.
* Chance values use a roll from 0 to 999.

sval.val: Add-Ons 2.0.4: Rebalanced starting Xenon station defenders.
Reduced station density (see Mayhem.GameCreator.SpawnXenons) is compensated by tighter ship-count ranges
and stronger capital-ship probabilities on higher difficulties. Added J and Z to M7 and M2 pool, with support ships included.
Chance values use a roll from 0 to 999.
